items.effect_on_cards: If the decider is off in production, compiled-lane cards come from the formula while the golden set measures the model's decisions. 'Golden green' then says little about what Rohit sees.
items.mistake: The golden harness pinned the decider on (engine_runner.py:69) while the code default stayed off, and the production value was never recorded.
items.correction: The production state is not wholly unknown. Prior-session memory why-no-cards-since-25-sep.md, measured 2026-10-01, records production with GENIOS_L4_LLM_DECISION_MAKER = true and no org allowlist, so it was ON for every org. The model then DEFERred every candidate during the 25 Sep spend-limit outage. The golden runner's own comment labels PRODUCTION_SWITCHES (engine_runner.py:67-70) as 'Production's overrides of the code's defaults'. So the golden setting matches production as last measured; it is not a configuration production lacks. Whether it is still on after the 18 Oct deploy needs a production env read.
items.verify_note: The code facts hold. reason/llm_decision_maker.py:9 says 'the model decides — act now (DECISION) or not yet (DEFER)'. enabled_for is at :118-128. config.py:110-113 has the switch default False, an empty org list, and a cap of 400 per org per UTC day per process. engine_runner.py:69-70 forces it True for every org. It is still called from decision_maker.py:1123, orchestrator.py:263 and fingerprint_inputs.py:38. Retirement is planned 'at cutover' in GeniOS-008 L2 00-START-HERE.md:62 (L2-H2).

items.title: YC-II D57 / F169: a file with no reply pattern yet is never re-examined, so silent investor outreach never resurfaces
items.expected: D57 recommendation: re-think a quiet file at its playbook's stage prior, else at the day ladder's rungs (7, 14, 30 days) while our ask or theirs is open.
items.actual: The default ('as built') still holds. Expert triggers fire on time only via reply_overdue/past_normal, which need the file's own measured usual gap. A one-touch wave has none, so after the first review ('wait') nothing re-thinks it. The fingerprint's 'quiet' rung changes, but a fingerprint change alone is explicitly not a trigger. Golden F15 (outreach to five funds, eight weeks of silence) is one of the 4 failing cases and carries this blocked_on.
evidence: genios_engine/reason/expert/triggers.py:24-30 ('Time passing is no trigger either, unless it crosses one of the file's own patterns')
genios_engine/reason/expert/triggers.py:150-173 (_crossings returns nothing when their_usual/our_usual is None)
genios_engine/reason/expert/fingerprint.py:84 ('quiet' in inputs) vs sweep.py:243-247 (no trigger → untouched)
items.fix: Rohit takes D57's recommendation. Claude adds a trigger: while an ask is open and the file has no usual, crossing the playbook's stage prior (card_lines.STAGE_PRIOR exists) or, failing that, DAY_LADDER rungs 7/14/30 brings the file back. The same rule goes into the L2 sweep's subject selection. Re-record F15 with the ideal reader.
items.effect_on_cards: A fundraising founder's investor wave that goes silent produces one 'wait' review and then never a card. Combined with the compiled lane refusing fundraising (D1), silent investors produce no card at all.
items.mistake: STEP-12 shipped with 'only the file's own pattern re-thinks a quiet file', although its own golden case F15 records this exact production failure. The decision has stayed open since 10 Oct.
items.verify_note: triggers.py:24-30 says time passing is no trigger unless it crosses the file's own patterns. their_usual (:127-135) returns None without a measured reply time or usual_gap. _crossings (:150-173) then fires nothing: REPLY_OVERDUE needs `usual`, PAST_NORMAL needs longest_gap_days, which a one-touch file lacks. fingerprint.py:86 puts 'quiet' in the inputs. sweep.py:243-247 leaves the file untouched when no trigger fires, and re-reviews only when a version moved and the file moved (:250-265). F15.json:309 carries the blocked_on. GeniOS-009 01-AS-IS-CARDS.md:25, 83 lists F15 as failing and wrongly silent on today's path. Note: on the L2 path, F15 instead produces 5 held investigation cards (01-AS-IS-CARDS.md:54). It still fails, but it is not silent there.

items.title: A lapsed trial, a full ingestion meter or the daily model cap silently stop Rohit's org; only a manual 'Sync now' still reasons
items.expected: The founder's own tenant is swept every tick (6 h heavy, 15 min light). Any refusal to sweep is visible to him, never only a log counter: capture is honest and coverage is stated.
items.expected_source: speedrun008/GeniOS-008/00-ARCHITECTURE.md 'Inside L1 — capture honestly'; genios_engine/platform/config.py:157-175 (scheduler cadence); F2 (Rohit: fewer cards, sometimes no reasoning)
items.actual:
Every signup is a 15-day trial with plan_expires_at set (api/auth_routes.py:79-87). run_billing_tick runs on every heavy tick: it moves a past-due org to 'expired' and gives it a 7-day grace window (platform/billing.py:172, 378-401). Since 7075014c (4 Oct; already on the production branch before the 18 Oct merge), the scheduled sweep skips an expired org's L1 pull (api/routes.py:1152-1155) AND drops it from the L3/L2/L4/L5 pass (api/routes.py:1228-1232). The warm lane also refuses its events (platform/warm_lane.py:171-176), and Ask returns 402 'Your trial has ended' (platform/billing.py:366-371, api/intelligence_routes.py:265-268). That commit measured on production: 'Rohit Swerashi grace closed 21 Sep'. No migration, script or doc after it extends that org's plan.

The dashboard's Sync now goes through a different door: POST /integrations/sync-all, then sync_jobs, then _onboarding_sync_bg. It checks only the daily LLM cap (api/routes.py:3952), then runs the full chain (api/routes.py:4030, 3784-3786). POST /sync/{id} (api/routes.py:923-951) and POST /connections/{id}/backfill (api/routes.py:1981-2040) check neither the plan nor the quota. So on a lapsed org, cards appear only after a manual Sync. Expert cards then drop out of the queue 168 h after their last decision (reason/expert/decide.py:154; reason/authority.py:251-263).

Two more gates also skip a connection. The ingestion meter skips it once source_events captured this period reach the plan's sync_messages (trial 1,000 per 15 days, individual 3,000 per 30 days; platform/billing.py:91-92; platform/quota.py:61-104; api/routes.py:1162-1167). The daily cap skips it at 20,000 calls or $25 of llm_costs (api/routes.py:3880-3914; platform/config.py:86). All three skips are only counters in the scheduler's INFO log line (api/routes.py:1234-1262). No l1_sync_runs row and no founder notice is written.

The 365-day resync's backfill route applies no quota. A large resync can therefore fill the meter, and the automatic sweep then stops polling new mail for the rest of the period. Separately, on a trial or individual tier (Plan.domains=1) the admin route refuses a second domain (api/admin_routes.py:1253-1272). Founder Office can then only be switched on through scripts/activate_tenant.py, which skips that check.
evidence: commit 7075014c message: 'Rohit Swerashi grace closed 21 Sep 12,831 calls … The sweep gates the L1 pull AND the L2/L3/L5 pass'
git merge-base: 7075014c is an ancestor of c501eec9^1 (production before 18 Oct)
genios_engine/api/routes.py:3952, 4029-4030, 4119-4137 (Sync now: only the daily cap is checked)
genios_engine/api/routes.py:923-951, 1981-2040 (per-connection sync and backfill: no plan or quota gate)
no doc under speedrun008/GeniOS-008, -009 or -010, or YC-II 08-FOR-HARSH, mentions the plan or quota gates on the sweep (grep)
items.fix:
Harsh: run the SQL below. If Rohit's org (or any design-partner org) is trial, expired or in grace, set it to a non-expiring internal plan (subscription_tier enterprise, plan_status active, plan_expires_at null, grace_until null), and the same for Sole Mate's tenant if it should run.

Claude, in code:
(1) Write every sweep skip (plan_expired, sync_quota, over_budget, paused) as an l1_sync_runs row with a reason, and surface it on the dashboard as one founder-readable line.
(2) Make the Sync job, POST /sync/{id} and the backfill door ask the same plan and quota gates as the sweep, or exempt them explicitly in one place.
(3) Let the resync reserve or bypass the quota by an explicit, logged decision, so it cannot silently starve the next period's polling.
items.effect_on_cards: If the org is lapsed, no automatic pass runs. Cards arrive only after a manual Sync, and existing expert cards leave the queue within about 7 days, which reads exactly as 'fewer cards' and 'sometimes'. Ask also answers 'Your trial has ended'. A full ingestion meter or the daily cap stops new mail reaching any card for the rest of the period or day, with nothing shown to Rohit.
items.mistake: 7075014c (4 Oct) measured that Rohit's own org was lapsed and then gated the sweep on that same lapse. Neither the commit nor any later doc or Harsh note records exempting or extending the founder's tenant. The gate was added to the sweep and the warm lane but not to the Sync-job door, so the same org behaves differently depending on which door ran.

items.title: Post-meeting follow-up cards ('meeting.followup') fail all three card doors: never on GET /cards, and 'Open card' gives a 404
items.expected: A P-16 post-meeting follow-up is a durable card in the founder's Cards queue, and the desktop moment's pinned open_card action opens it.
items.expected_source: genios_engine/reason/meetings/passes.py:1-30 (SCREEN_INTEL_P5 §3, P-16); genios_engine/reason/team/emit.py:1-25 (card + moment, 'readable … through the moment's open_card')
items.actual:
emit_followups calls emit_situation with capability_id='meeting.followup' (reason/meetings/passes.py:46, 360-368). The emitter writes the signal with rule_id = capability_id = 'meeting.followup' and no reasoning run (reason/team/emit.py:279-299).

No door admits that card:
- The P4 situation door requires split_part(capability_id, '.', 1) in ('team', 'verify') (deliver/store.py:29-31). 'meeting' fails it.
- The decision door needs a reasoning run.
- The question door needs the founder_question builder.

So the card is missing from queue() (deliver/store.py:777-788) and get_authoritative_card returns None (deliver/store.py:650-691). GET /cards/{id} then answers 404 'card not found or no longer actionable' (api/routes.py:5401-5406, 5568-5571). The desktop moment's open_card goes to /dashboard/cards?card=<id> (dashboard origin/main Extension/src-tauri/src/moments/actions.rs:106), which hits that 404. Team ('team.deadline_at_risk', 'team.readiness') and verify ('verify.situation') cards pass, so only meeting follow-ups are lost. items.title: 'Sync now' runs a second copy of the chain: no funnel numbers, no meeting/team/verify post-passes, and none of the sweep's plan or quota gates
items.expected: One chain with one sweep id: every pass that makes cards relays its five funnel numbers, so production card volume can be measured ('one source per number').
items.expected_source: genios_engine/api/routes.py:767-794 (THE FUNNEL'S ONE SWEEP ID; _count docstring)
items.actual:
The scheduled sweep runs _run_l2_chain (api/routes.py:738-864): provision, process_pending (5,000), funnel observe ×5 (793), _charge_ingestion (805), run_all, build_cards, run_post_passes for team, verify and meetings (854), then _reclaim_after_sweep (862).

The dashboard's Sync now runs a different function. It goes POST /integrations/sync-all, then a sync_jobs worker, then _onboarding_sync_bg, then _process_and_reason_unlocked (api/routes.py:3793-3868, 4029-4030, 4043-4078, 4119-4137). That function runs provision, process_pending in 500-event chunks, run_all and build_cards only. It writes no pipeline_counters rows (funnel.observe is called only at api/routes.py:793), runs no post-passes, and charges no ingestion. Its only gate is the daily model cap (api/routes.py:3952). The purge is global, so the next sweep covers it.
evidence: genios_engine/api/routes.py:793, 805, 854, 862 (the only call sites of funnel.observe, _charge_ingestion, run_post_passes, _reclaim_after_sweep)

Corrections that change the plan:
1. F1's '18 Oct deploy' is not supported. c501eec9 first reached origin/harsh/mvp in the 21 Oct 16:20 UTC push (869 commits), and 480f7cd4 says prod ran 10 Oct code on 19 Oct. The real deploy date is a Harsh fact (S01.U3).
2. Migrations end at 0250, not 0249. 0250 is claimed three times, so every new migration in this plan says '<next free, >=0251>' and gets its number at build time.

Dependency conflicts resolved:
- goals-g009-d1-d2-d8 says it depends on l2-a2-a3, but the goal decisions do not need the L2 cutover. S26 can run in parallel; only S29 (the L2 proposer) needs S24/S20.

- l2-held-card-engineer-template depends on the STEP-13b decision because both edit verify.py and claim_check.py, so S20 is not start-now.

Standing rules for every unit:
- Each code unit gets its own tests plus a mutation proof with a clean baseline and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
- Root and platform guards run per group of 2–3 units, and full suites run in CI.
- One writer per file. Shared hot files are serialised: api/routes.py goes S03.U1 → S02.U5 → S10 → S14.U2 → S17.U3 → S34.U1 → S35.U3 → S39.U1, and reason/domain_shadow.py goes S18.U1 → S18.U4 → S24.U2 → S25.U4 → S34.U2.
- Dashboard and Mac changes are a clickable dummy first, then Rohit's approval, then real files. A 'ha' to a plan is not a go.
- The L3 folder waits for Rohit to open L3.
- Never repair distinct_days before ADR-10, and calibration_apply stays off (D13).
- Founder golden cases cannot name Antler or Theresa (REAL_NAMES), so F72 is a synthetic analogue.
- Paid passes always start with 1–2 probe calls. Thinking eats max_tokens on Claude 5.

Production SQL is not run in any start-now unit. S01.U1 only writes the read-only runner, and Rohit's permission gates the run (F6).
